snippet.textDisplay:
3:00:20
As a gun nerd, I feel obligated to answer: Lucia keeps pulling back the slide to reset the hammer, as most semi-automatic weapons are "single action," as in pulling the trigger only lets the hammer fall forward and nothing else. If the hammer is already down, like firing a weapon on empty, then the trigger does nothing. For dry firing training, this is to help with trigger discipline, so the trigger pull is the same weight as when firing live rounds, and to practice not pulling the weapon off target.
